image: "https://camo.githubusercontent.com/54f926defabf895bcb021405306688fe808a09a5d0a0ed5cfe5dfe6b69bff379/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f674f326d77514b2e676966"
abstract: |
  I was kinda obsessed with the game [Cave Story](https://www.cavestory.org/download/cave-story.php)
  for a long time. I wanted to expand on it, make it look better (3D, lighting,
  ...) and also be able to play it with my friends online.
  Remind you, back then in 2015-2027 the software-development landscape was
  much harsher than today. There were no game engines that would allow you to
  all that! (At least I did not know of any?). Also, my budget was 0€, so
  I needed to get creative. This is the result:
---
